description: Watch any public page for changes: we fetch it now (robots.txt respected), fingerprint its text and return a token. Send that token next time and get changed yes/no plus the blocks added and removed since your last check. Nothing is stored on our side. Option to ignore number-only changes. Price: $0.002 in USDC per call (x402 or prepaid credits). In the free trial.

ignoreNumbers.description: Treat changes that only touch numbers (counters, timestamps, prices) as no change. Set on the first check; the token remembers it.

token.description: The token from your previous check of this page (omit on the first check).

name: page-changes

added.description: Text blocks that are new since the last check (up to 30).

removed.description: Starts of blocks that disappeared (up to 30).

token.description: Keep this and send it with your next check.

title: Page changes ($0.002)
